techniques.name: Dismount → Drill → Procri's finish
steps: Poke with horse right-click to bait enemy cooldowns
DRILLLLL, preferably on the enemy's back
Procri's Grift if enemy is still alive, for the free kill
techniques.rhythm: Drill is best used after a dismount, preferably on the enemy's back — otherwise "legit z dmg"; usable from the ground too if the enemy is stunned or you have a straight back-attack positional advantage.

gameplay.text: Gameplay is straight forward, look for undefended prey, poke with horse right click (try to bait some cooldowns from enemy), dismount, DRILLLL and procri's if enemy is still alive for the free kill.

Supporting units: play wisely when engaging to support your units — diving with horse into blobs or over-committing to Hurricane can get you destroyed. For starters, focus on maximizing hero-and-unit synergy (cav/exo/static units/standalone units, etc).

Hurricane is a multi-purpose stagger (hero/unit) plus a very quick passive stacker: "you can legit dismount behind units, hurricane, and it will be very hard for anyone to reach you," and it staggers all units not blocking it.
Procri's Grift is "the last hitting god." In stalemate setups, spam it aiming at any exo hiding behind blobs — "Legit SPAM this skill, takes like 3 to 5? to kill hidden exos like cocos/flames."

Lugh's March is the only CC recovery available; use wisely, or use while aiming at the enemy hitting you to prevent unwanted damage/CC. Because you block while using it, be mindful of after-animation block usage — if your block breaks, getting hit again can lead to unwanted stun.
